title: The Shocking Truth Behind Organic Fruits and Vegetables – It’s NOT What You Think!  Dr. Mandell
summary: A doctor explains that organic food is not pesticide-free or meaningfully more nutritious, and that eating more produce matters most.

assertions.quote: organic and conventional foods are very similar in terms of vitamins, minerals, and overall nutritional value
Some research has also found that slightly higher levels of antioxidants in organic produce
there is no strong evidence that eating organic changes your metabolism, your energy, or your overall health
What does matter most, according to nutritional experts, is simply eating more fruits and vegetables.
Organic foods are often significantly more expensive
organic farming is more labor-intensive and yields are often lower
the health risks from the tiny amount of pesticide residues found on most foods are extremely low anyways
Whether it's organic or not, junk food is still junk food.
